title: Telling whether a LoRA works
hook: Same seed, off and on. Then a strength sweep and more than one seed. How to get an answer you can trust from a few renders.

verified.claim: Strength enters the weight as a straight multiple, and both strengths at 0 returns the inputs unchanged.
The pixel differences of the real picture pairs were computed from train_art at 256 x 256: about 0.13 for the lighthouse, 0.25 for the harbour, 0.23 for two unrelated base pictures.

unchecked: The sweep and seed numbers come from a small stand-in network, not an image model, so its near-straight line is not a claim about any real LoRA. Real sweeps can bend far more or less.
Our real pictures are two prompts at one seed each, at strength 1. We have no sweep from a real LoRA in this lesson.
That testing with several seeds and four on/off pictures is enough is our advice, not something proved.
